facts.text: Students can earn a Bachelor of Science in Dental Hygiene (BSDH) in 20 months following 33 credit hours of prerequisite general education coursework.

sources.title: Utah College of Dental Hygiene
sources.quote: At UCDH you can earn a Bachelor's Degree in Dental Hygiene (BSDH) from a private college in only 20 months*. This unique program is the only one of it's kind in Utah.
